show.description:
In a world where love and betrayal walk hand in hand, one girl’s journey transforms her from innocence to unstoppable power.
Her past is filled with pain, her present with determination, and her future with destiny.
She rises against all odds not just to survive, but to conquer.
A story of sacrifice, resilience, and revenge… where every secret has a price, and every truth changes everything.
